# NimbleZTA v0.1.2 - Table of Contents

Add Zero Trust Authentication (ZTA) to web apps running in your private cloud

## Modules

- [NimbleZTA](https://nimble-zta.hexdocs.pm/NimbleZTA.md): Enable Zero Trust Authentication within your Plug/Phoenix application,
mostly geared towards internal applications.
- [NimbleZTA.BasicAuth](https://nimble-zta.hexdocs.pm/NimbleZTA.BasicAuth.md): Use basic authentication as Zero Trust Authentication (recommended for dev/tests/staging).
- [NimbleZTA.Cloudflare](https://nimble-zta.hexdocs.pm/NimbleZTA.Cloudflare.md): Use Cloudflare for Zero Trust Authentication.
- [NimbleZTA.GoogleIAP](https://nimble-zta.hexdocs.pm/NimbleZTA.GoogleIAP.md): Use Google IAP for Zero Trust Authentication.
- [NimbleZTA.PassThrough](https://nimble-zta.hexdocs.pm/NimbleZTA.PassThrough.md): A pass-through Zero Trust Authentication (recommended for dev/testing/staging).
- [NimbleZTA.Tailscale](https://nimble-zta.hexdocs.pm/NimbleZTA.Tailscale.md): Use Tailscale for Zero Trust Authentication.
